title: LLM4Rail: An LLM-Augmented Personalized Railway Services Platform
abstract: arXiv:2507.23377v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly reshaped different walks of business. To meet the increasing demands for individualized railway service, we develop LLM4Rail - a novel LLM-augmented personalized railway services platform. Empowered by the LLM, LLM4Rail provides dedicated modules for ticket and weather inquiries, food & drink recommendations, and casual conversation. In LLM4Rail, we propose the iterative "Experience-Retrieval Question-Thought-Action-Observation (ER-QTAO)" reasoning framework. It introduces two key mechanisms, Experience Storage and Retrieval (ESR) and Diagnostic Observation Generation (DOG), to enhance the LLM's ability to invoke appropriate external tools with complex arguments. translated_title: LLM4Rail：一个由大语言模型增强的个性化铁路服务平台
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已经深刻地重塑了各行各业。为满足日益增长的个性化铁路服务需求，我们开发了LLM4Rail——一个新颖的由大语言模型增强的个性化铁路服务平台。在大语言模型的赋能下，LLM4Rail提供了专门的模块，用于车票与天气查询、餐饮推荐以及闲聊对话。在LLM4Rail中，我们提出了迭代的“经验-检索-问题-思考-行动-观察（ER-QTAO）”推理框架。该框架引入了两个关键机制：经验存储与检索（ESR）和诊断性观察生成（DOG），以增强大语言模型以复杂参数调用恰当外部工具的能力。为了提供个性化的车上餐饮服务，我们首先构建了中国铁路餐饮数据集，该数据集涵盖了按城市、菜系、年龄段和辣度级别分类的众多特色菜肴。
tldr: 该论文提出了LLM4Rail个性化铁路服务平台，其核心创新是包含经验存储与检索（ESR）和诊断性观察生成（DOG）两大机制的迭代式ER-QTAO推理框架，并构建了中国铁路餐饮数据集（CRFD）以实现个性化的车上餐饮推荐服务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LLM4Rail, an LLM-augmented personalized railway services platform featuring an iterative ER-QTAO reasoning framework with two key mechanisms—Experience Storage and Retrieval (ESR) and Diagnostic Observation Generation (DOG)—along with the newly constructed Chinese Railway Food & Drink (CRFD) dataset for personalized onboard dining services.
